title: Greetings and Polite Words
introduction: Learn about greetings and polite words through simple examples and practice.
definition: Greetings help us start conversations. Polite words help us show kindness.
rules: Use a greeting when you meet someone.
Use polite words when asking for help, thanking someone or apologising.
Practise short conversations with a parent, teacher or friend.
Say thank you when someone helps you.

vocabulary.description: A greeting used in the morning.
A greeting used in the afternoon.
A greeting used in the evening.
Words often said before going to sleep or leaving at night.
Polite words used to get attention or pass someone.
A friendly greeting for someone arriving.

examples.question: You meet a teacher at 8 a.m. What can you say?
A friend lends you a crayon. What can you say?
You accidentally bump into someone. What can you say?
You ask for a drink. What can you say?
Someone says thank you. What can you reply?

exercises.question: Complete: Good ___ (before sleeping).
exercises.solution: Use the greeting said before going to sleep.

exercises.question: Complete: Thank ___.
exercises.solution: We say this polite phrase when someone helps us.

exercises.question: Complete: Water, ___.
exercises.solution: Add a polite word when asking for something.

exercises.question: Complete: Excuse ___.
exercises.solution: Use this phrase to get someone's attention politely.

exercises.question: What can you say after accidentally stepping on a foot? (sorry or hello)
exercises.solution: Say sorry when you accidentally hurt someone.

exercises.question: Complete: Good ___ (after lunch).
exercises.solution: Afternoon is the part of the day after noon.

exercises.question: Complete: See ___.
exercises.solution: This is a friendly phrase used when saying goodbye.

exercises.question: Complete: You are ___.
exercises.solution: This polite reply is used after someone thanks you.

summary: Greetings help us start conversations. Polite words help us show kindness.
